purpose: Research registry of external IPA/G2P candidates. Entries are not active runtime dependencies and are not accepted pronunciation gold data.

integration_contract.pipeline: source orthography -> language-specific structural/phonological analysis -> typed IPA result -> ClippyFirst IPA-to-Ukrainian adapter -> practical Ukrainian orthography
prohibited: silently rewriting external output into IPA without a documented conversion
using unverified output as gold data

benchmark_protocol.scoring_gate: Only independently adjudicated, non-empty gold_ipa rows are scored.
benchmark_protocol.notes: Registry membership does not establish language support, IPA output semantics, reproducibility, accuracy, or license compatibility. Preserve raw output and record exact versions and model/data licenses.

observed_experiments.configuration: base engine; optional thaiphon-data-volubilis lexicon not installed

observed_experiments.notes: No gold labels. `ไกล`: thaiphon splits into /kaj˧/ /la˦˥/, FastThaiG2P returns /klaj˧/. `จริง`: thaiphon returns /tɕa˨˩/ /ri˦˥/ /ŋa˦˥/, FastThaiG2P returns /t͡ɕiŋ˧/. These are high-priority lexical/segmentation disagreements, not a winner determination.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream reports ~57% exact match base engine and ~75% with optional thaiphon-data-volubilis on its own Wiktionary-derived corpus, and ~73% on a PyThaiNLP G2P cross-check.
upstream_evidence.caveat: These denominators and conventions differ from ClippyFirst; do not compare directly to our unscored 36-item smoke run. The lexicon is separately CC-BY-SA 4.0; engine code is Apache-2.0.

upstream_evidence.fact: Upstream describes a 62,112-word IPA dictionary plus rule-based fallback and reports generated IPA entries among sources.
upstream_evidence.caveat: Review dictionary source overlap, generated-label provenance, and dataset licenses before treating as a gold resource.

upstream_evidence.fact: README lists Thai among supported languages and labels output phone set IPA.
upstream_evidence.caveat: No pinned Thai output or gold evaluation in this repository.
